problems.note: VERIFY checked: the marked answer is correct. 10 bars shared by 3 friends gives 3 1/3 each, and by 6 friends gives 1 2/3 each, so the 3-friend group gets more. The choices are group names, though, and a child hearing 'Who gets more each? 3 friends or 6 friends?' may not realise the answer is the share size, not the group. Consider adding the amounts to the narration or making the question 'Which way gives each friend more?'.

The intro says 'Look at the picture', but the app is audio-first and several items have no picture (tap-7, keypad-4, number-line-3's narration is spoken only). Consider wording like 'Listen, then tap or type your answer.'
